title: Recognised Visa Sponsors and English-Speaking Job Ads in the Netherlands, November 2026
description: Every IND-recognised sponsor (public register for work, 2026-11-03) with live job ads in the Netherlands, matched by organisation name to 28,577 live Dutch job ads seen November 10-24, 2026, with counts of ads open to English speakers and ads written in or asking for Dutch; plus German and Dutch cities and job families by share of English-friendly ads. Full report and method: https://www.qarera.com/reports/netherlands-visa-sponsors-english-jobs-2026
